source: in-situ 3D PSF (psf3d, 2026-11-11) of /mnt/data/dmdsf/bn_dnapaint/dnapaint/2.5nM/2/cover1_600mW_5.5ms_cf660.tif: fit_psf_tracks on its own isolated tracks (frames < 30000), Zernike 5-21 + focus + line blur, then frozen + photoselection per pattern angle (gamma, zeta; photosel 3); camera / pattern blocks copied from calib_2p5nM_m2_sc.json

camera.note: gain 0.56; offset map = loc-masked temporal median minus smooth of this movie (masked by baseline smlm.hdf5, frames 0-20000); read noise = 0.5 nM map shifted by the sensor ROI offset (dy,dx)=22,2 + high-passed own estimate where uncovered

pattern.steps: frame%6; angle=step//3; I = A*relint*(1+depth*cos(k.r - phase - dphi(t))), r=(x=col,y=row) px
pattern.depth_note: 0.925/0.955: cross-cycle estimator, nn_overlap>=3 subset (real 0.920-0.927 / 0.953-0.954); bench v2 shows this subset within ~+0.02 of truth (worker, 2026-11-08). step_fit regression depth is diluted and must not be written to pattern files.

pattern_note: placeholder copied from calib_0.5nM.json; only needed by Simulator init (PSF column); run_uncalibrated estimates the pattern from the data and uses only PSF + camera from --calib

psf3d.note: image-plane blur covariance px^2 [sxx, syy, sxy] (VectorialPSF.blur); psf_dipole_M_angle = emission-dipole tensor per pattern angle (frame % 6 // 3), M_a = (1 - gamma) diag((1 - zeta)/2, (1 - zeta)/2, zeta) + gamma e_a e_a^T; see docs/PSF_POLARIZATION.md; THIS FILE = the average of the two axis PSFs (pattern-free consumers)
